CEPCI.description: Chemical Engineering Plant Cost Index (composite CE INDEX, 1957-59=100), published by Chemical Engineering magazine. Values quoted with attribution for cost escalation; CEPCI is a trademark/publication of Chemical Engineering (Access Intelligence) and the current series is available by subscription at https://www.chemengonline.com/pci-home.
CEPCI.basis_note: Publisher's spliced historical series. The January 2002 methodology revision normalised revised sub-indexes to the old index at January 2001; pre-2001 history was not recalculated (Vatavuk 2002).
CEPCI.licence_note: Each value cites its publisher source. Do not add values from secondary sources; add 2025+ values only from Chemical Engineering issues or the publisher's site, with issue and page.

CEPCI annual averages 1987, 1996, 1997 and 2000-2024 added 2026-11-12 and verified against the publisher (COST-DATA-V01); used only when a policy sets equipment_index_series and the target period has an observation.
